bio: I'm a freelance solutions engineer building and improving software and workflows for local businesses.
I use AI throughout how I design and ship for faster iteration, clearer specs, and solutions that stay practical to run long after handoff.
My background spans cybersecurity, cloud computing, and full-stack development.

expertise.title: Solutions Engineering
expertise.body: Scoping problems, shipping software, and improving operational systems. Building anything from customer-facing tools to backends that keep businesses running.

expertise.title: AI-Augmented Development
expertise.body: Applying modern AI tooling to accelerate development, documentation, and troubleshooting without sacrificing maintainability or security.

expertise.title: Security & Cloud Computing
expertise.body: Hands-on SOC operations, KQL threat detection, and infrastructure work across Azure, GCP, and AWS.
